Each site retains real exit-code semantics (set -euo pipefail plus explicit if ...; then echo FAIL; exit 1; fi on every failure branch, propagated grep exit under set -e where unguarded) — none degrade to the echo-only always-exits-0 anti-pattern. The narrowed pattern correctly still matches a reintroduced bare 'prior_feedback:' dispatch key (anchored on start-of-line or a non-word/non-underscore boundary before the literal) and correctly excludes 'docs_prior_feedback' (the mandated loop-internal identifier, preceded by '_' which the [^_a-zA-Z] boundary excludes, and never followed by a bare ':' in this plan's usage).
